summary: Tested Quick Stats summary screen feature added to VoiceLoggerSession. Found and fixed 1 critical bug in IncomeExpenseTracker.jsx (onSessionSaved closing overlay before summary could render). After fix, all 11 test cases passed including summary screen display, all UI elements, Done button, 6s auto-dismiss, and regressions.

integration_issues.flow: Voice Session → Save All → Summary Screen
integration_issues.issue: FIXED: onSessionSaved callback in IncomeExpenseTracker.jsx called setShowVoiceSession(false) which unmounted VoiceLoggerSession before summaryData state could render. Fixed by removing setShowVoiceSession(false) from onSessionSaved handler (overlay now only closes via onClose called by Done button or auto-dismiss timer).

regression_voice_session_btn.details: data-testid='start-voice-session-btn' visible with text 'Voice Session' in tracker header

voice_session_overlay_opens.details: Click Voice Session → data-testid='voice-logger-session' overlay opens correctly

summary_screen_appears_after_save_all.details: Inject 3 mock items + click Save All → data-testid='session-summary' appears after batch API call succeeds

trophy_icon_with_badge.details: Trophy icon present with absolute-positioned saved count badge showing '3'

stat_cards_all_4_present.details: All 4 stat cards found: Items Logged (3 transactions), Total Spent (R650.00), Session Time (00:01), Top Category (Transport / R500)

biggest_expense_card.details: Biggest expense card shows 'Petrol fill-up' at R500.00 with transport emoji icon

month_comparison_row.details: Month-to-date row shows before→after amounts with '+R650 this session' badge (monthTotals passed from IncomeExpenseTracker)

auto_dismiss_countdown_text.details: Auto-closing in Xs text visible with spinning Loader2 icon (e.g., 'Auto-closing in 4s')

done_button_closes_overlay.details: data-testid='summary-close-btn' click removes both session-summary and voice-logger-session from DOM, returns to tracker

auto_dismiss_6s.details: After ~6s, overlay completely removed from DOM without Done button click. Tracker page reloads and shows updated totals.

regression_speak_transaction_btn.details: data-testid='voice-record-btn' with text 'Speak Transaction' still present in Add Transaction tab

action_items: FIXED: IncomeExpenseTracker.jsx - onSessionSaved now only calls loadTransactions() (removed setShowVoiceSession(false)) so the overlay stays open until user clicks Done or auto-dismiss fires via onClose
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: IncomeExpenseTracker line 594 - onSessionSaved was closing the overlay immediately after batch save, preventing the summary screen from rendering. The onSessionSaved callback should only reload data; closing must happen via onClose. Fixed.

NOTE: onSessionSaved is now called twice in the auto-dismiss path (once in saveAll, once in dismissCountdown countdown reaching 0) - calling loadTransactions twice is harmless but slightly redundant. Low priority.
NOTE: Month comparison 'before' value uses monthTotals at the time Save All is clicked (correct). The 'after' value is calculated as monthTotals.expenses + totalExpenses from session (correct).
seed_data_creation: Multiple test transactions created during batch API calls in testing (R150 food, R500 transport, R3000 salary items × multiple test runs)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Summary screen feature in VoiceLoggerSession.jsx fully tested and working. Critical bug fixed: IncomeExpenseTracker.jsx onSessionSaved no longer calls setShowVoiceSession(false). data-testids confirmed: session-summary (summary container), summary-close-btn (Done button). Auto-dismiss countdown starts at 6s and calls onClose when it reaches 0. monthTotals correctly passed from IncomeExpenseTracker to VoiceLoggerSession as prop. State injection approach for testing: React fiber dispatch on voice-logger-session element. Trophy badge = absolute-positioned div with class '-top-2 -right-2'. Stat cards in 2×2 grid.
